dedupe_keys.name: leap centrifuge test and numerical simulation specifications

description: LEAP Centrifuge Test and Numerical Simulation Specifications is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Ekin Gultepe, University of Canterbury (canterbury.ac.nz). The dataset was developed to provide a common set of specifications for centrifuge model tests and corresponding numerical simulations. It serves as a reference resource for researchers investigating liquefaction behavior, centrifuge modeling, and numerical simulation of geotechnical earthquake engineering problems. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project with 17 top-level files (PNG, XLSX, PDF, CSV, JPG). Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2159t. Keywords: centrifuge test, numerical simulation, LEAP, earthquake engineering, databases. Published 2015-12-08. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
